name: relic-of-the-clouds
description: Relic of the Clouds - jogo pronto para virar APK (Capacitor)

scripts.android:add: npm run www && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.js

scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
